role: The 1 Hz live-workout loop on WorkoutTicker: timer, auto-pause/resume, RR ingest and HR derivation, Watch-routed strap fallback, HR-source arbitration (pure HRArbitration enum), motion/power mirroring, per-second samples, crash backups, live AI broker snapshot, Watch/Zwift pushes, environment refresh and voice-coach tick.
types: WorkoutTicker.HRArbitration: enum — pure HR source priority/strap-notice decision
WorkoutTicker.HRArbitration.Decision: struct — display HR update / strap notice / clear flag
toplevel: Static constants only; no other top-level code.

units.does: Invalidates any previous tick timer, clears hrFromWrist and wristHROffsets, and schedules a repeating 1.0 s Timer (tolerance 0.25) in RunLoop.main .common mode whose block hops to MainActor and calls runTick on the (weakly held) recorder.
One tick: returns unless phase is .recording; evaluates auto-pause/resume; increments elapsedSeconds when not paused; runs incrementalBackupTick.
units.entry: Timer block installed by startTicker (1 Hz, RunLoop .common).

branches.effect: false: tick does nothing; true: continues
true: elapsedSeconds += 1; false: clock frozen (tick work still runs)

units.does: If the current session has a sport: while running, accrues stationary ticks and may auto-pause; while auto-paused, accrues moving ticks and may auto-resume; manual pause is left alone.

branches.effect: true: moving accrual/auto-resume; false (manual pause): nothing

units.does: Decides whether the user is stopped: indoor sports use cadence <= 1 spm (nil cadence = not stopped); GPS sports use CoreLocation speed < 0.3 m/s (negative/no fix = not stopped).

branches.effect: true: cadence path; false: speed path
false: returns false (unknown not stopped); true: returns speed < 0.3

flags.text: Indoor auto-pause needs pedometer cadence to reach <= 1 spm, but WorkoutPedometer.apply only overwrites cadenceStepsPerMin when CMPedometer supplies a non-nil currentCadence; when steps stop and no update or a nil cadence arrives, the last walking cadence stays in place, so a treadmill stop never satisfies isStopped and the 15 s auto-pause does not fire, contrary to the comment that cadence 'goes to zero within a few seconds'.

units.does: Decides whether the user is moving again: indoor cadence >= 60 spm (nil = no), GPS speed >= 0.8 m/s (no fix = -1 = no).

branches.effect: true: cadence path; false: speed path

units.does: Feeds isStopped into AutoPauseDetector.accrueStationary and calls recorder.pause(isAuto: true) on the tick it returns true (15 consecutive stationary ticks).
Feeds isMovingAgain into AutoPauseDetector.accrueMoving and calls recorder.resume() on the tick it returns true (3 consecutive moving ticks).
Invalidates and nils the tick timer.

Installs an ObservationLoop subscription (initial: true) on PolarManager.currentHeartRate, holding the recorder weakly, whose onChange mirrors each value into workoutHR via mirrorStrapHeartRate; stores the handle in hrSubscription.
Sets workoutHR.currentHR to the Polar HR (including nil), clears hrFromWrist, and raises peakHR if the new value exceeds it.
units.entry: ObservationLoop onChange callback for PolarManager.currentHeartRate (installed by observeHeartRate, strap source only).

branches.effect: true: peakHR = newHR; false: peak unchanged

units.does: Per-tick work: sets beatCount from the Polar RR buffer, runs crash backups, ingests new strap beats/derives HR, consumes Watch-routed strap beats, arbitrates HR source, mirrors motion/power, updates live pace, captures the per-second sample, publishes the AI broker snapshot when the assistant is enabled, runs sport-scoped work (Watch push, thresholds, route detection, Zwift, environment, voice coach), and ticks the interval controller with total distance.

branches.effect: true: publishes live broker snapshot; false: skipped
true: runs sport-scoped tick work; false: skipped

flags.text: The interval controller is ticked every second even while the workout is paused (manual or auto): IntervalController.tick measures step time by wall clock (Date() - stepStartAt), so a timed interval step keeps elapsing and can advance/announce the next step during a pause or traffic-light auto-pause.

units.does: Sport-scoped tick stages in order: push live state to the Watch, update threshold breach counters, attempt one-shot route detection, push HR/power to the Zwift broadcaster, refresh weather/geocode, tick the voice coach.

If a session is open: launches a detached utility task that writes the RR buffer to RawRRBackup.incrementalBackup (self-throttled ~60 s) and, when that wrote, uploads it via CloudKitSyncManager.uploadLiveBackup; then persists the GPS/baro/sample track if changed.

branches.effect: false: no CloudKit upload; true: uploads live backup

flags.text: The crash backup (RawRRBackup.incrementalBackup + CloudKit live upload) is fed only the phone's Polar buffer; beats that arrived through the Watch-routed strap fallback live only in memory in watchRoutedRRBuffer until finalize, so a crash or kill mid-workout loses every Watch-routed beat.

units.does: Advances the TrackBackupWatermark with track count, barometric count and newest sample offsetSec; when anything changed, takes and appends a track snapshot.

flags.text: The watermark is meant to skip the full-array `.map` snapshot on ticks with nothing new (WorkoutRecorder.swift:203-209), but a sample row is appended on every unpaused tick, so the samples mark changes every second and the whole track/baro/samples arrays are copied every tick during an active workout; the skip only happens while paused.

units.does: Snapshots the whole location track (PersistedFix), barometric samples, workout samples and wrist-HR offsets on MainActor and appends them in a detached utility task via WorkoutTrackBackup.appendIncremental for crash recovery.

If the Polar RR buffer grew since lastIngestedPointCount: feeds the new slice to the live DFA analyzer, derives HR as median of the last 8 beats and writes currentHR/peakHR, clears hrFromWrist, stamps lastStrapHRAt; advances lastIngestedPointCount. With no new beats it only ticks the DFA clock.

branches.effect: false: dfa.tick() and return; true: ingest new slice
true: updates display HR + lastStrapHRAt; false: HR untouched

units.does: Median of the positive rr_ms values in the slice converted to bpm (60000/median); nil if none positive.

branches.effect: true: mean of the two middle values; false: middle value

units.does: Watch-routed strap fallback: if the Watch strap payload is < 10 s old, drains the bridge's pending RR queue (bounded to plausible values); when the phone strap is not live (no RR in 5 s) synthesizes RRPoints, appends them to watchRoutedRRBuffer, feeds the DFA and applies the Watch strap HR. Drained beats are discarded while the phone strap is live.

branches.cond: Watch strap timestamp exists and < 10 s old
branches.effect: false: returns (queue not drained); true: drains

branches.cond: drained beats non-empty and phone strap not live
branches.effect: false: returns (beats dropped if phone live); true: synthesize
true: returns; false: buffer + DFA + HR

flags.text: lastConsumedWatchStrapAt is written here (and reset at start) but never read anywhere; the WorkoutRecorder.swift:260-262 comment says it dedupes re-ingest of the same payload, which is actually done by draining the queue.

units.does: Raises watchRoutedCumulativeMs to the batch start's offset from sessionStartDate (never lowers it).

branches.effect: false: returns unchanged; true: max(existing, sinceStart)

units.does: Epoch ms of the phone strap stream start (PolarManager.streamingStartTime), else workout start, else 0.
True when the phone-paired strap produced RR-derived HR within the last 5 s.

Turns drained Watch RR values into RRPoints: back-dates the batch start by the summed RR duration from the payload arrival time, aligns the cumulative t_ms clock, and assigns each beat t_ms (cumulative), rr_ms, wallClockMs relative to the phone stream base, and the plausible Watch strap HR.

branches.effect: appends a point and advances both clocks by rr

units.does: Writes the plausible Watch-routed strap HR into currentHR/peakHR (clearing hrFromWrist) when present, and always stamps lastWatchRoutedHRAt.

branches.effect: true: display/peak updated; false: only freshness stamp

units.does: Builds HRArbitration inputs (source mode, elapsed, strap and Watch-routed silence durations, fresh wrist HR, strap feed status), applies the decision to the display HR, and updates lifecycle.strapNotice when it changes (logging a raised notice).

branches.effect: true: logs warning; false: cleared silently

units.does: Applies a decision: copies wrist HR into currentHR (raising peak) or clears currentHR when all sources are silent; sets hrFromWrist via displayIsWrist.

branches.cond: decision has a wrist HR update

branches.effect: true: currentHR = nil; false: display untouched

units.does: Returns the Watch's plausible wrist HR if it was received within 30 s, else nil.

branches.cond: plausible wrist HR and receive time both present

units.does: Mirrors sensors into WorkoutMotion: footPodActive; distance (rower: PM5 odometer; else max of foot-pod, GPS and pedometer distances with paused stretches removed); elevation gain; live track; step count; cadence (rower stroke rate, else foot pod, else pedometer); then tallies power (rower PM5 or foot pod).

branches.cond: row and PM5 reports a distance
branches.effect: true: distance = PM5 odometer; false (non-row, or row with no PM5 distance): max(foot-pod, GPS, pedometer) with paused stretches removed
true: PM5 stroke rate; false: nil

branches.cond: ?? stroke rate nil (non-row, or PM5 has none)

branches.effect: fallback pedometer cadence (may itself be nil)
true: tallies PM5 instantaneous power; false: tallies foot-pod instantaneous power

flags.text: Doc says for .row 'GPS / pedometer / foot-pod values are all noise here… the rower's odometer / SPM / watts win', but when the PM5 reports no distance or stroke rate the code falls back to GPS/pedometer distance and foot-pod/pedometer cadence for a rowing session.

units.does: Sets motion.powerWatts to the live watts and adds to the running sum/count/max; nil watts clears powerWatts without tallying.

flags.text: Power is tallied on every tick including paused ones: runTick calls incrementalBackupTick while paused and mirrorMotionAndPowerSensors -> tallyPower is not gated on isPaused, so any non-nil reading during a pause (e.g. 0 W from an idle PM5 or foot pod) is added to powerSampleSum/Count and the session's average power stored at finalize is diluted by paused seconds, while the per-second samples skip them.

units.does: When not paused and a sport is known, appends a WorkoutSample (offset, HR, distance, pace, cadence, altitude, α1, METs, power), records the offset in wristHROffsets if the HR is the Watch's wrist HR, then caps memory at 12 h.

branches.cond: not paused and session sport known
branches.effect: false: returns (paused seconds absent from series); true: appends
true: offset recorded as wrist HR

units.does: Builds one WorkoutSample from current recorder values, with METs from WorkoutRecorder.estimateMETs (pace-based) and user max HR.

Paused or no sport: resets LivePaceEstimator. Otherwise feeds it a Reading with fused distance, GPS distance (outdoor), pedometer distance (step sports, paused stretches removed), foot-pod speed and GPS speed (outdoor).

branches.effect: true: GPS speed from current location; false: nil

units.does: If more than 43,200 samples, drops the oldest and filters wristHROffsets to those at or after the first kept row.
Returns offsets >= firstOffset, or all offsets when firstOffset is nil.
Publishes a LiveWorkoutSnapshot to LiveWorkoutBroker built from the current location, valid course, speed, last sample, strap silence and live zone breakdown.
Returns the location's course when >= 0, else nil.
Seconds since the last strap RR-derived HR, only for strap-source workouts with a timestamp; else nil.
Computes the HR zone breakdown of all workout samples against the user's max HR.
Maps a course in degrees to an 8-point compass label (N, NE, … NW) using 45° slices centred on each direction.

Constructs the AssistantContext.LiveWorkoutSnapshot literal: sport, timings, HR/peak/max, beats, distance, steps, cadence, elevation, α1 band/status/fit, strap state, GPS, pace/speed/power/METs, splits, position/heading/cardinal, grade, units, target zone, recognised route, road geocode fields, route topology, weather, live trends, historical baselines, readiness/ATL/CTL/TSB, projections, zone seconds, race predictions, thresholds and interval progress.

flags.text: Builds the same live state as WorkoutAIContextBuilder.buildContext, which the voice coach gets on the same tick, recomputing zone breakdown and WorkoutLiveTrends over the full sample array twice per tick; the two have already diverged (buildContext passes GPS-only `recorder.location.distanceMeters`, this passes the fused `recorder.distanceMeters`), so chat and voice see different distances indoors.

units.does: Returns 'reverse'/'forward' for an auto-detected route's direction, nil for user-chosen or no route.
Grade-adjusted pace from current pace and current grade.
Projected minutes until fade from the samples and current HR drift.
Recovery hours needed from today's cached ATL/CTL.
Maps userThresholds into ThresholdSnapshot values (id string, metric, condition, value, debounce, cooldown, cue).
Re-keys thresholdBreachSec by UUID string.

Sends a WatchConnectivityBridge.LiveState to the Watch: sport, HR/peak/max, elapsed/distance/elevation totals, formatted pace, α1/band/status, cadence, target zone, units, recording/paused/autoPaused flags, pace.
Runs one-shot route auto-detection when no route is planned, it has not been attempted, and the sport uses GPS.

branches.cond: no planned route, not attempted, GPS sport

units.does: Pushes the live HR and power to the Zwift BLE peripheral broadcaster (no-op when not broadcasting).
Refreshes weather when the assistant is on or heat tracking is on for a GPS sport, and refreshes road reverse-geocoding only when the assistant is on.

branches.cond: assistant enabled or (heat tracking and GPS sport)

units.does: Builds the WorkoutAIContext and passes it to the voice coach's trigger evaluation.
Whether the display after a decision is wrist HR: true if wrist HR copied in, false if cleared, else the previous value.

branches.cond: decision has a display HR update

units.does: Pure decision: display HR update, strap notice, and clear flag (clear only when no update and all sources silent).
Whether every source the mode relies on is silent: strap mode — both strap channels silent > 10 s and no wrist HR; watch mode — no wrist HR; none — false.

branches.effect: both strap channels silent past 10 s and no wrist HR

units.does: Wrist HR to copy into the display: strap mode only when both strap channels silent > 10 s; watch mode always the wrist HR; none → nil.

branches.effect: guard both channels silent > 10 s else nil; returns wrist HR (may be nil)

branches.cond: guard strap and Watch-routed silent > 10 s
branches.effect: false: nil (strap paths own the display)

units.does: Strap notice: only for strap mode, after 15 s elapsed, with both channels silent > 10 s; .waitingForStrap → strapNotConnected, .stalled → strapSilent, .settingUp/.live → nil.

branches.cond: strap mode, past grace, both channels silent
